ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_logsigmoid_weighted_sum_margin_smooth_clamped
ir.intuition: This loss retains the smooth margin with sigmoid-scaled advantage_gap and tanh-scaled delta_rank while replacing the weighted log-mean-exp aggregation with a simpler weighted sum aggregation. The clamped margin-adjusted log-likelihood difference ensures numerical stability, while the weighted sum aggregation emphasizes direct summation of the weighted losses, reducing complexity yet preserving stability and gradient flow.
ir.pseudocode:
adv_scaled = sigmoid(advantage_gap) * margin_adv
rank_scaled = tanh(delta_rank) * margin_rank
margin = adv_scaled + rank_scaled
x = alpha * scale * (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) - margin
x = clamp(x, -20, 20)
loss_per_pair = -logsigmoid(x) * weight
loss = sum(loss_per_pair) / (sum(weight) + 1e-8)
return loss
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    delta_rank = batch['delta_rank']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)

    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.2))
    margin_adv = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('margin_adv', 0.05))
    margin_rank = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('margin_rank', 0.02))

    adv_scaled = ops.sigmoid(advantage_gap) * margin_adv
    rank_scaled = ops.tanh(delta_rank) * margin_rank
    margin = ops.add(adv_scaled, rank_scaled)

    x = ops.sub(ops.mul(alpha * scale, ops.sub(lpw, lpl)), margin)
    x = ops.clamp(x, -20, 20)

    loss = -ops.logsigmoid(x)

    if weight is None:
        weight = ops.ones_like(loss)

    weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    loss_scalar = ops.div(ops.sum(weighted_loss), ops.sum(weight) + 1e-8)
    return loss_scalar
